name: Rosé Pine
description: Rosé Pine (rose-pine/rose-pine-palette): base chat, surface panels, overlay sheets, iris accent, foam links.

palette_roles.surface: Secondary background: floating panels, input fields, status bars
palette_roles.overlay: Tertiary background: hovered items, selection, dialogs
palette_roles.muted: Low contrast fg: comments, disabled labels
palette_roles.subtle: Medium contrast fg: secondary text, placeholders

ansi_source: https://github.com/rose-pine/kitty/blob/main/dist/rose-pine.conf ; syntax from https://github.com/rose-pine/neovim (lua/rose-pine.lua); cursor text = text, as upstream (cursor_text_color)

light.source: https://github.com/rose-pine/palette/blob/main/palette.json (dawn; roles per README) ; highlight_* from rose-pine/neovim lua/rose-pine/palette.lua ; ANSI from rose-pine/kitty dist/rose-pine-dawn.conf

preview.embed_desc: All natural pine, faux fur and a bit of soho vibes

notes: Variant: Rosé Pine. Palette from rose-pine/rose-pine-palette palette.json; highlight low/med/high (not in palette.json) from rosepinetheme.com/palette.

Roles follow the per-colour usage docs in rose-pine/rose-pine-site: base = primary background, surface = inputs/status bars, overlay = dialogs, highlight_med = hovered popup items, subtle = secondary text, muted = disabled/dimmed labels, love = errors, gold = warnings, pine = affirmative signals, foam = informational.
Secondary (channel list) uses surface rather than base (the docs put sidebars on base) so the channel list separates from chat. Tertiary = base: nothing darker in the palette.
Accent: iris. Rose is the namesake, but love (danger) and rose are only ~19° apart in hue — closer still in Moon — so iris keeps danger clearly distinct. Links use foam (informational).
Strong and normal text are both 'text': the palette has a single high-contrast foreground.
Positive/online uses pine, the documented affirmative colour (Rosé Pine has no green).
Placeholder text uses muted (the build groups placeholders with muted text); the docs suggest subtle for placeholders.
Derived: brand_bright = 60% iris + 40% text; BRAND_560 = 70% iris + 30% base.
Pine (online/positive) is only 3.38:1 on base in Main — fine for status dots, dim for status text.
